limitations: No optimality is claimed among all bounded or convex sets or at fixed eccentricity; the square-root rate is not asserted to be a universal lower bound. The theorem is an L2 statement for the standard double Hilbert transform in R2, and the sharp logarithmic asymptotic is specific to the truncated-strip family. The closest source is very recent, so unindexed concurrent observation remains a residual originality risk.
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
record_title: Exact elliptic quasi-eigenvectors and sharp strip leakage for the double Hilbert transform
